input.quote: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created specifically for Customer and leaves Customer only a revocable, term-limited licence, which fails both the preferred position (Customer owns deliverables with Vendor assignment) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables). The remaining preferred elements already sit in the contract: 14.3 retains Vendor Technology (Vendor's pre-existing IP) and applies the perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence in 13.2 to Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable, 14.1 keeps all Customer Data rights with Customer, and 14.4 creates no joint ownership. The single word-level edit flips ownership to Customer and adds Vendor's assignment, leaving the rest of 14.2 and Vendor's retained rights untouched.

ops.oldText: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, which Vendor hereby assigns to Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for, so 14.2 flips to Customer ownership of each Deliverable with an assignment from Vendor; Vendor still retains Vendor Technology under 14.3 and 13.2 gives us the perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP.
proposal.summary: Flip Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment

mappings.quote: 13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.

mappings.element: Customer retention of all rights in Customer Data.
mappings.quote: 14.1 As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.
14.4 No jointly owned intellectual property is created unless the Parties sign a separate instrument identifying it and their exploitation rights.
